mh3.text: Meren of Clan Nel Toth is forced to drink the Dreamfire Draught and face an elemental, which she destroys using necromancy, and the elders deem her dangerous, so she leaves the clan for Grixis.
Trained in Grixis, she reanimates a great dragon, Skaal Kesh, and attacks her old home, killing most of its residents.
She duels her old master Kael, whom the dragon devours, and resolves to topple Jund.
